info.title: MenuMusicNX
info.author: Fimochi
info.details:
HOME Menu background music for Nintendo Switch.

MenuMusicNX automatically plays music while the HOME Menu is in the foreground, pauses when you launch a game, and resumes from the same position when you return HOME. Version 1.0.1 adds a smooth fade-out when entering games and fade-in when returning to HOME.

Features:
• Automatic HOME Menu/game detection
• Smooth fade-in/out transitions
• MP3, FLAC and WAV support
• Tesla music browser
• Startup playlists
• Volume control
• No manual play/pause required

MenuMusicNX is a fork of sys-tune, redesigned specifically for HOME Menu music using pdm:qry focus events and qlaunch detection.

IMPORTANT: MenuMusicNX uses the same sysmodule title as sys-tune and will overwrite an existing sys-tune installation, so uninstall sys-tune first.

Tested on Atmosphère firmware 20.1.5.

Bring proper HOME Menu music to your Switch — like the Wii, Wii U and 3DS!


...o yeah also theres the github page for more info: https://github.com/Fimochi/MenuMusicNX
